facts.note: States that when the temple bell struck nine, his watch showed twenty minutes to nine, and that his uncle made a scene about it in front of everyone.
States he went up to the library after dinner and stayed there alone.

States that at eighteen minutes past ten by his watch he heard a thump on the floor right above him in the atelier, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes he counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones he did not count.

States that at a quarter past ten by his watch someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door, and at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch someone came quickly down; he did not see who and the door was shut.
States that Bastien Girard came in at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch and they sat together until the temple struck eleven.
